Root_preload_fix.primary_hypothesis: Editor asynchronous texture platform-data compilation can expose placeholder GetSizeX/Y or resource state even after LoadObject and render Flush. FinishCompilation is required before the existing render flush.
Root_preload_fix.API: FinishCompilation(TArrayView<UTexture* const>) matches TArray<UTexture*>; UTexture2D* upcasts to UTexture*; header and call WITH_EDITOR gated; called in ordinary game-thread HUD BeginPlay, outside PostCompilation callbacks.
Root_preload_fix.SDK_evidence: Texture2D.cpp explicitly documents placeholder size queries during async compile and FinishCompilation prerequisite; CreateResource registers incomplete textures and may create placeholder resources. TextureCompiler.cpp waits pending texture compilation, calls PostCompilation which completes platform cache and UpdateResource, then existing HUD Flush consumes resource commands.
